title: Harden public agent runtime integration
description:
Purpose: provide stable, supported Tactus APIs for model setup, lifecycle telemetry, serialization, and prewarming so consumers do not replace private runtime methods.

Definition of Done:
- Agent configuration and lifecycle hooks are public and tested.
- LLM prewarming moves import/setup work outside interactive requests.
- Pydantic JSON serialization is native.
- Release artifacts and documentation are published with full CI green.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Started a bounded host-neutral external-child wait increment under story tcts-393fe9 and task tcts-0beb7f. The primitive will checkpoint opaque child references, yield a distinct waiting outcome without threads or timeouts, and replay against a host resolver until all or any requested children are terminal. Host polling, persistence, authorization, and product status mapping remain outside Tactus.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Consumer release validation exposed the exact dependency boundary: a clean Python 3.11 install from the current Plexus lock imports published Tactus 0.51.5, but full test collection fails because tactus.core.exceptions does not export ProcedureWaitingForChildren. The locally divergent Python 3.12 environment passing is not package evidence. Delivery is being isolated onto a clean branch based on the structured-HITL commit, including only tcts-393fe9/tcts-0beb7f and tcts-b872be/tcts-5bdd8f behavior; unrelated model-attempt authority work remains excluded. Required proof before release: both Gherkin features, focused runtime/sandbox/CLI/memory tests, full Tactus quality gates, wheel install/import, then clean consumer Python 3.11 and 3.12 suites with no source override.
